title: Help Me Help You: The Aggregate Value of Source and Target Data in Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2408.16189v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transfer learning, in regression or classification, concerns problems where one aims to use imperfect data from a source distribution P to improve prediction w.r.t. a target distribution Q. While there is now much theoretical understanding of the unsupervised setting of this problem (where no labeled target data is available), the supervised setting with labeled target data remains under-studied.   We identify and characterize an interesting dichotomy in the rates achievable in the supervised setting: there is a weak transfer regime where optimal rates are determined by information in either the source or target dataset but not both, and a strong transfer regime where much faster target rates are achievable, accounting for complementary information in source and target data. translated_title: 帮我帮你：迁移学习中源数据与目标数据的聚合价值
translated_abstract: 迁移学习（无论是回归还是分类任务）所关注的问题是：如何利用来自源分布 P 的不完美数据来改进针对目标分布 Q 的预测。尽管目前对这一问题在无监督设置（即没有带标签目标数据可用）下已有大量理论认识，但带有标签目标数据的监督设置仍然研究不足。我们识别并刻画了监督设置下可实现的收敛率中一个有趣的二分现象：存在一个弱迁移机制，其中最优收敛率由源数据集或目标数据集中某一方的信息决定，而非两者共同决定；还存在一个强迁移机制，在该机制下可以实现快得多的目标收敛率，这需要同时考虑源数据和目标数据中的互补信息。此外，虽然先前针对无监督设置的理论工具可以扩展以刻画弱迁移机制，但我们认为它们无法捕捉（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了监督迁移学习中的两种机制二分现象：弱迁移机制下最优收敛率仅由源数据或目标数据之一决定，而强迁移机制下需联合利用源与目标数据的互补信息才能实现快得多的目标收敛率。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies a dichotomy in supervised transfer learning between a weak transfer regime, where optimal rates are determined by either the source or target data alone, and a strong transfer regime, where much faster target rates are achievable by leveraging complementary information from both datasets.
